en.title: Wonderful Words of Life
en.author: Philip P. Bliss
en.chorus:
[E]Beau[B7]tiful words, won[E]derful words,
Wonderful [B7]words of [E]life;
Beau[B7]tiful words, won[E]derful words,
Wonderful [B7]words of [E]life.

notes: Text and lineation from Timeless Truths, which prints the six-line stanza the 8.6.8.6.6.6 meter requires; the Cyber Hymnal runs lines 5–6 together and reads 'sanctify us forever' (seven syllables, one too many for the tune) and 'blessèd'. Tune WORDS OF LIFE (Bliss, 1874); hymnary.org/tune/words_of_life_bliss lists it in F, and E is the nearest of the preferred guitar keys (one semitone down; G would be two). Chart derived from the Cyber Hymnal MIDI (mid/w/o/n/d/e/wonderful_words_of_life.mid) transposed F->E.
